intro: Stout to Kadrell is an Alliance delivery quest that leads travelers out of the frozen heights of Dun Morogh and into the temperate valley of Loch Modan. Entrusted with a cask of Rejold Barleybrew's newly perfected Shimmer Stout, you carry the potent brew across the territorial border to share with Mountaineer Kadrell on patrol in Thelsamar.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I've been drinking more of that Shimmer Stout my brother made - it's great stuff! I want a fellow Mountaineer to try it. His name's Kadrell, and he's usually patrolling the road through Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
To get to Thelsamar, go southeast through the tunnel, then turn northeast when the path forks into a road. Follow that road straight into Thelsamar.
Give Mountaineer Kadrell this cask of Shimmer Stout and see what he thinks!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings, adventurer, and welcome to Thelsamar!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now, let me have a taste...
Magni's Beard! This stuff gets your head turning! And it lightens the limbs, too.
I feel like I can fly!
